goal: Keep valid transactions with relative locktimes in the mempool when a chain reorganization lowers the tip
Stop spurious eviction of transactions with unconfirmed parents and all of their descendants
agreement: Substantive support with all review objections resolved
Verified regression test fails on master and passes on branch (Bortlesboat)
Support after adopting general recalculation for mixed inputs (ismaelsadeeq)
Approval after settling caller-side check and mocktime tests (Bicaru20)

categories.name: mempool

Prevents mempool disruption for users sending transactions with relative locktimes and unconfirmed parents
